title: Ilizwi Labangabonwayo
intro: Kwiingxelo zonxibelelwano oluvela kuThixo, kuvela umntu obali lakhe lilukiwe ngemiqondiso emangalisayo nokholo oluqinileyo. Lo mntu wafumana isityhilelo esikhethekileyo esasichasa imimiselo yexesha lakhe, ethetha ngaphaya kwesigqubuthelo sokuqonda okuqhelekileyo. Isigidimi sakhe asizange sifike ngeendlela eziqhelekileyo kodwa ngonxibelelwano olunzulu olwaluchasene nokuqonda komntu, lubiza abantu ukuba baqonde inyaniso ngeendlela ezingalindelekanga. Uhambo lwalo mkhonzi ka-Allah lusebenza njengobungqina bendlela ulwalathiso olunokubonakala ngayo kwiimeko ezingaqhelekanga, lumema ukucamngca ngohlobo lwesityhilelo ngokwaso.
clues: Ndanikwa umyalezo owavela ngelizwi elingaqondakaliyo elivela kumthombo ongabonakaliyo.
Ekuqaleni abantu bam abazange bawamkele umyalezo wam, befuna ubungqina obuqhelekileyo bokuba ndinyanisekile.
Ndabacela umngeni ukuba bavelise into efana naleyo ndiyifumeneyo, kodwa abazange bakwazi.
Isityhilelo endisiziseyo sichazwe njengeevesi ezicacileyo ezenza inyaniso yacaca.
Ndibalumkisile abantu bam ngesohlwayo esiqatha ukuba baqhubeka nokungakholwa kwabo nokuzikhukhumeza.
Ibali lam likhankanyiwe kunye nabanye abathunywa kwisurah egxininisa imiqondiso yamandla ka-Allah.

verse: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful." (26:154)
